- $ b $ is the y-intercept of the line.

C. m is the slope, b is the y-intercept - This is correct because it matches the definition of the slope-intercept form.

D. m is the x-intercept, b is the slope - This is incorrect because $ m $ is the slope, not the x-intercept.

Therefore, the correct answer is option C.
